summary: Very steep, narrow bush-edged lane with houses 8-9 m away and no room to pull off.
reasons: Houses within 8-9 m of the kerb
Narrow lane, bush and fences either side

drivers.seclusion: Bush to the east, but mapped dwellings sit 8 m and 9 m from the kerb and the only gaps are on a steep drop.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane falling steeply to the south; no clear ground beside it for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet lane, with a busy arterial in the bush beyond to the east.
drivers.convention: No parked vehicles or campers seen; no signs.

flags: Arterial road noise from the east
sun_shade: Heavy tree shade from the east bush; houses to the west.
